brief: (a) 2-storey stone row house for Cliffhold, F08#3
author: Claude (coordinator-side Cloudreach Meshy art worker), owner-authorized Meshy use (Standing owner direction 1, 15 Oct 2026)
workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from repo references (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro, references as data URIs) -> inspected -> Meshy 3D (latest, quad remesh, PBR textures embedded in GLB)

native_size.note: Meshy raw GLB, longest side ~1.9 units

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z

previews: preview_3view.png (software flat-shaded 3-view, colours sampled per face)
files.raw_glb: not published (identical mesh to glb_metres minus the metres_root node)

concepts.prompt: Two-storey stone row house for a high cliff-top sky city, 10 metres wide, 7 metres deep and 9 metres tall to the ridge, a solid rectangular block built entirely of coursed pale limestone ashlar like the round watch tower reference, with a carved stone string course between the floors and heavier corner quoins. Steep slate-blue tiled gable roof with a small stone chimney and two small dormers. Ground floor: an arched wooden door in a pointed stone arch and two pointed-arch windows; upper floor: a row of three tall pointed-arch windows with stone mullions and warm amber glowing glass, like the arch window reference. A royal-blue fabric banner with gold trim and a pale wing emblem hangs from a gold bracket beside the door. Same family as the watch tower and the aviary gate references: civic, refined, castle-town stone, not a rustic village cottage. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no cast background, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) in coursed ashlar blocks with soft moss in the joints; slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66), honey-coloured timber only for doors and shutters, royal-blue banner fabric with a small gold accent and pale wing emblem. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. No half-timbering, no cream plaster, no thatch. Flat ground contact at the base.
references: local: assets_raw/props-1020/cloudreach_watch_tower_house/thumbnail.png (published Meshy asset cloudreach_watch_tower_house on tb/meshy-props, style anchor)
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN (view 0 only): strong 3/4 view, all-stone ashlar, slate-blue roof with dormers, pointed-arch amber windows, blue wing banner; views 1-2 rejected because they dropped the roof

concepts.verdict: rejected for 3D source after test: consistent 3 views with roof, but its model m_c2 came out square-footprint and darker/browner than the watch-tower family

models.verdict: rejected: near-square footprint (raw 1.25 x 1.26 units, about 10 x 10 m at 10 m width, 15 m tall), darker tone, facade less crisp

visual_verdict: Strong: two-storey coursed pale limestone house with quoins, carved string course, steep slate-blue gable roof with two dormers and chimney, three tall pointed-arch amber windows above, arched timber door and two arched windows below, blank party-wall sides suited to row placement. Same family as cloudreach_watch_tower_house; no half-timbering or plaster, so it does not read as Meadows. Proportions are taller than the brief: at the 10 m width target it is 6.47 m deep and 14.17 m tall (alternative uniform scale 4.7273 gives 9 m tall on a 6.35 x 4.11 m footprint). The concept's door banner is only a thin sliver in the mesh. Single material.
integration_note: candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: no red/oxblood requested or observed; slate-blue roof, royal-blue banner, gold accents only
